current_evidence: The council's minerals & waste / council-own-development planning page (last modified 17/06/2026) still links this PDF as the 'local list of validation requirements', and the document text dates itself March 2016 (2015-16 update of the 2013 North Yorkshire Planning Authorities list); however ordinary applications are validated against separate per-former-district lists linked from each area page (e.g. Ryedale area page).

issues.detail: Grokbot's link is the County Planning Authority list used for minerals, waste and the council's own (Reg 3) development. Since 2023 North Yorkshire Council validates householder and other district-level applications against separate lists for each former district area (Craven, Hambleton, Harrogate, Richmondshire, Ryedale, Scarborough, Selby). Those area lists are not captured, so the Householder and Full planning rows do not describe what most applicants actually have to submit.
issues.evidence: Ryedale area page: service 'is delivered differently in each area of the county'; links 'National and local validation requirement for planning applications in the Ryedale area'. Other area lists exist, e.g. /2023-03/Validation guidance may 2021 - na.pdf and /2023-03/150304_Application_Validation_Requirements_v6-Final 2023 - na.pdf

issues.detail: The list date 2023-07-01 comes from the upload folder in the URL. The document itself is the March 2016 update of the 2013 NYPA joint list.
issues.evidence: Document text: 'Validation Requirements for Planning and Other Applications ... March 2016' (2015-16 update)

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none)', but checklist NYPA1 (Householder) sets out local requirements. Missing items: Biodiversity/Geological Survey and Assessment Report (where protected species, designated sites, priority habitats or geological features are likely to be affected); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (where habitable windows may lose light or be overshadowed, or where a building taller than one storey is within 2 m of a neighbouring residential boundary); Parking Assessment (where parking or turning space is reduced, access changes or the property is significantly enlarged); Tree Survey/Arboricultural Implications (where works are within 10 m of the crown spread of a TPO tree or a conservation area tree).

The document has 17 per-type checklists (NYPA1 to NYPA17), covering for example listed building consent (NYPA4), lawful development certificates (NYPA6), approval of details (NYPA12), s73 variation (NYPA13), minerals/waste (NYPA15) and onshore oil and gas (NYPA17). Grokbot still marked Lawful development cert, Discharge of conditions, Variation of condition s73, Advertisement consent and County own devt as '(none)'. It also has no row at all for onshore oil and gas (NYPA17), which has its own validation requirements PDF.
issues.evidence: Planning page links NYPA2, NYPA4, NYPA6, NYPA7, NYPA10, NYPA12, NYPA13, NYPA15 and NYPA17 validation requirement PDFs (2023-10 uploads)

issues.detail: Almost every tab_item is boilerplate rather than a requirement. Examples: pre-application process text ('Pre-application advice is encouraged...', 'acknowledge the receipt ... within five working days'), form download/contact links ('Contact us for a paper copy...', 'Certificate of ownership A (pdf / 220 KB)'), e-submission file-size rules, references to guidance booklets, and a fragment listing designated site types.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' section, taken from the planning page and the PDF

issues.detail: About 30 requirements are tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The source does name the application types: NYPA2 covers outline OR full applications, NYPA1 householder, and so on. Several items are placed wrongly. Street scene elevations and the domestic wind turbine noise item come from the householder checklist. Lighting Assessment and Heritage Statement are filed under Listed building consent only, but they apply to planning applications generally. 'Lawful development evidence (sworn affidavits)' comes from NYPA6 (certificate of lawfulness) but is filed under Non-material amendment.
issues.evidence: 'NYPA2: Application for outline or full planning permission'; NA row trigger text runs 'Sworn affidavit(s)... Required where the application is for an existing use ... NYPA7: APPLICATION FOR A NON-MATERIAL AMENDMENT'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are cut-off fragments that do not say when the requirement applies. Examples: Telecommunications 'Radiation Protection (ICNIRP).'; Character appraisal 'to any Conservation Area Appraisal Document...'; Sequential test 'to support a sequential test for the proposed development.'; Affordable Housing, whose trigger merges the headings of three requirements; and Waste/Refuse storage, which is actually odour/ventilation text for waste sites.

The BNG row cites the 12 February 2024 statutory date from the web page, not the 2016 list. Duplicate rows also appear: Coal Mining/Land Stability and Ground investigation share an identical trigger, and so do Daylight/Sunlight and Sunlight to gardens.
issues.evidence: Identical trigger_excerpt 'Geotechnical Survey/Stability Report/Coal Mining Risk Assessment...'

summary: Grokbot captured the 2016 North Yorkshire Planning Authorities (county matters) list, dated it wrongly to 2023 and missed the per-former-district validation lists that North Yorkshire Council actually uses for most applications. The extracted items are largely boilerplate, and the Householder and other per-type checklists are wrongly shown as having no local requirements.
